title: Integrative Multi-Omics and Machine Learning Identify ID1 as a Candidate Gene Associated with Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm
summary: The analyses identify ID1 as a candidate gene consistently associated with abdominal aortic aneurysm and immune/vascular transcriptional changes. The finding is supported by independent public datasets and single-cell expression analysis, but no functional experiment establishes that ID1 causes aneurysm pathology.
ai_technology: LASSO, random forest, and SVM-RFE prioritized genes from public transcriptomic datasets for cross-dataset comparison.
